instruction.text: Sometimes, we don’t have enough money for a thing we want in our budget. In these situations, we have to save up. Select somewhere we can keep our savings.

feedback.end: This is a piggy bank. A piggy bank is one place where people put money while saving.

instruction.text: Valentina has been mowing her grandparents’ lawn every Sunday and has earned a total of £20. She wants to save half of her money and spend the rest. Divide the money equally between the piggy bank and the shopping basket.
Valentina has £10 to spend. Select all the things in the shop that cost £10.

text: Valentina decides to buy a teddy bear with the money she earned. She saves the other £10 for something else in the future.

instruction.text: All of these words have something to do with money. Match the word with its meaning.

b.sound: to put money to the side for another time
to get money for finishing a task
to use money to pay for things
